title: coelopleurum brevicaule
intro: Coelopleurum brevicaule, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family that is native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to relieve pain, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Coelopleurum brevicaule include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral agent, making it effective in treating a range of conditions, including colds, flu, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Coelopleurum brevicaule include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
